quarterly_data.signal: ZEUS headline-results company announcement: ziltivekimab did not reduce MACE versus placebo in people with ASCVD, CKD and inflammation (hazard ratio 0.99; 95% confidence interval 0.88 to 1.11). The company said the outcome will not impact its previously communicated 2026 adjusted operating profit outlook but will result in a non-cash impairment charge in Q3 2026.
quarterly_data.figure: MACE hazard ratio 0.99 (95% CI 0.88 to 1.11); non-cash impairment charge in Q3 2026; no impact on 2026 adjusted operating profit outlook
